name: Chhatradol Social Welfare Organization
description: A full-stack web platform for Chhatradol Social Welfare Organization (ছাত্রদল সমাজকল্যাণ সংস্থা), a public charitable trust. Public website plus member and admin portals with attendance, monthly contributions, donations (Razorpay) and post management, powered by React, Vite and Supabase.
